notes.title: Update to v. 1.0.9198 on the Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Howdy Partner!

We have another update applied on the beta branch for testing before releasing it. So, without further ado:

How do I play on a beta branch?
[list]
[*] A quick guide:
[*] Prerequisite: You must have Wild West Dynasty in your library – of course.
[*] Open your games library. Right-click on Wild West Dynasty.
[*] Open the ‘Properties’ menu.
[*] Click on the ‘BETA’ tab.
[*] Use the drop-down menu and select ‘Public Staging Branch’. This is the beta version of the game.
[*] Click ‘Close’.
[*] Steam should now download this version of the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/a7edc847a4812b08391efade8584e569e4ca5453.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missing cutscene related to the Mercedes quest.
[/list]

[h3]Changes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pathfinding system improvements. NPCs should not become stuck if the destination is not reachable or blocked for it.
[*] The cutscene music has been changed.
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cookbook recipes could not be analysed properly.
[*] Manage House radial menu icon colour.
[*] The house's custom name was not saved properly.
[*] NPC were sleeping above the bed (their ability to levitate removed).
[*] NPC could not be assigned properly to different Workstations if they are currently working in the stable.
[*] Wrong map indicator for arable area.
[*] Tools in the shop display were not stacking.
[*] Rawhide was not displayed in the resources category.
[*] Some technology recipes were not saved after unlocking them.
[*] The campfire in the old camp could cause camera issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Wild West Dynasty – Update on the Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Howdy Partner!

We're back! We have a new update for you that we'd like to test on the beta branch before releasing it into the wide-open spaces of the prairie. So, without further ado:

How do I play on a beta branch?
[list]
[*] A quick guide:
[*] Prerequisite: You must have Wild West Dynasty in your library – of course.
[*] Open your games library. Right-click on Wild West Dynasty.
[*] Open the ‘Properties’ menu.
[*] Click on the ‘BETA’ tab.
[*] Use the drop-down menu and select ‘Public Staging Branch’. This is the beta version of the game.
[*] Click ‘Close’.
[*] Steam should now download this version of the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/a7edc847a4812b08391efade8584e569e4ca5453.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] The ability to move settlers to different houses
[*] A panel to manage houses in Management tab
[*] The ability to have more than one settler in one house
[*] The ability to assign a house to yourself
[*] Indicator in radial menu showing that crafting multiple is RMB
[*] Resource list the player needs for buildings in the building wheel
[*] Added more save slots and the ability to label them. Saves can now be deleted.
[*] The ability to name horses
[*] The ability to destroy just tents
[*] The ability to paint the roof triangle on a house
[*] Added 32 new investigation recipes (for cooking)
[*] More saddles are available for purchase at Four Nines
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed Annie's mail from the ground
[*] Horse options to mount/dismount and a horse menu
[*] The map is centring on the player when opened
[*] Local transport now does not cost any money (in range of a city)
[*] Transport system has been updated – after removing a city, every transport will be updated. If the destination for a transport is a removed city – the transport will be cancelled and will return to the starting point.
[*] Removed the seeds tutorial/tip
[*] Removed Ed's and Roger's tutorial/tip
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Annie now marks her promised location.
[*] All fires supply warmth now
[*] The first fire should not have the Analyse option 
[*] Created a marker for “can be eaten” for NPCs in the menu. It is a checkmark instead of an X.
[*] Granger’s behaviour when dead
[*] Items stacking is now working
[*] All the buildings are now destructible. Including the warehouse! And the Barn!
[*] Fixed an issue where post-processing was not working in animal’s buildings (barn/pigsty/ranch/stable)
[*] Fixed an issue where the detection of animal buildings was not working properly (player could not see name or health of the building)
[*] Fixed an issue where the Barn was not showing its name and health and could not be destroyed
[*] Fixed wrong names displayed on animal’s buildings
[*] Fixed an issue with loading map state after save/load
[*] Fixed an issue with loading Granger’s state
[*] Fixed an issue where the Barn’s marker was not visible on the map after loading a saved file
[*] Fixed an issue where the Windmill marker was not visible on the map after loading a saved file
[*] Fixed an issue where the Mine marker was not visible on the map after loading a saved file
[*] Fixed the de-synchronisation of animals
[*] Fixed an issue with roof material in winter
[*] Food now is updated on a daily basis, instead of every hour (food loses 40 points of condition per day)
[*] Fixed an issue where items prepared with the cookbook were not transferred into rotten food if their condition reached 0
[*] Granger, Owl and Grama Lucy now offer things to buy after reaching a certain point in the storyline
[*] Fixed an issue with scroll in the Journal and notes panel
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix to 1.0.9094
notes.notes:
Howdy Partner!

Again a small hotfix bringing a few fixes.

We are working on further updates! Thank you for your active support!

[list]
[*] NPCs will not kill young animals in cages (less than 10 years).
[*] NPCs will transfer a maximum of two food items into the cage from storage in one cycle.
[*] The food and water consumption of caged animals is significantly reduced.
[*] NPCs assigned to cages housing animals should no longer trigger a crouch-stand-crouch action when managing the cage.
[*] NPCs assigned to animal cages will now transfer water/food for animals. Condition: the cage does not contain 25 water units or 99 food units. [i](Dev note: We do want to give you a better option to manage animal cages. We are working on solutions. You will be able to control how many items the NPCs shall add to the cage's storage, to keep the economy and cycle balanced in your city.)[/i]
[*] The water consumption for animals in barns is significantly reduced.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could plant seeds with insufficient amounts in the inventory[i] (Note: this could have caused the -x value).[/i]
[*] The Workshop craft hierarchy now reflects the technology tree.
[*] The weight of Henrietta and Ada's letter are reduced to zero (0).
[*] Fixed an issue where assigning NPCs to the Barn/Sawmill in Ghost Town could corrupt saving those buildings.
[*] Fixed an issue where a transport route could break the saving process
[*] Fixed an issue where having a windmill, farm plots and/or barn and having NPC assigned to the barn, could cause save issues. [i](Note: We are still investigating issues when sometimes buildings are not saved.)[/i]
[*] Fixed an issue where a canteen was not providing water for NPCs in the city.
[*] Fixed an issue where outpost buildings could not be destroyed.
[*] NPCs working on a farm will take only as much seeds as required, depending on farm size.
[*] Changed the cost of crafting a colt bullet from 10 shells and 10 gun powder, to 1 respectively.
[*] Fixed an endless loop Mercedes – Confront the Sheriff.
[*] Increased the health of houses.
[*] Settlers are no longer eating up buckets. Empty buckets will be automatically returned to the warehouse storage. The support for animals is work in progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix to 1.0.9089

Howdy Partner!

To start the week, we have another hotfix for you, which brings these bug fixes and optimisations!

We are working on further updates! Thank you for your active support!
 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Pantry could freeze players after saving/loading.
[*] Fixed an issue where items in Pantry could duplicate after saving/loading.
[*] Fixed an issue where taking items from Pantry was corrupting them, if these items had the same definition (like for example mushrooms).
[*] Removed corrupted food copies from pantry after saving/loading.
[*] Animal cages now show the amount of food/water items available for these animals instead of corresponding progress bars.
[*] Fixed an issue where flowers were not visible in animal cages as food.
[*] Carter Ash cannot be assigned multiple times to a house.
[*] Added a fallback if Grandma Lucy will glitch herself underground. After saving/loading she should be back on the surface.
[*] Carter Ash cannot be talked to before starting The Promise.
[*] You are back! - Elmer is now giving the player a key after the final quest.
[*] The player cannot die as long as he is in the cooking panel.
[*] Crafting planks – fixed an issue with a "nil" value displayed in the chapter entry.
[*] Added destructible planks in the Granger house.
[*] Fixed an issue where the trader was not selling a rifle.
[*] Disabled the option to show the render debug panel.
[*] Fixed an issue where the render debug view could be enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue with extremely large sized saves. Shops could feature too many items - causing those saves – after loading. They will now reset to a default stock.
[*] Fixed an issue where city missions could not be completed for specific requests of animal types.
[*] Changed the Unstuck logic. Now the player will teleport to a nearby house after clicking Unstuck.
[*] Default Unstuck position has changed to the start position in Ghost Town now if no houses are built yet.
[*] Fixed an issue where jills (female hares) were not numbered to the chapter.
[*] Fixed an issue where animals in cages could not reproduce.
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs were planting potatoes in winter only.
[*] Fixed an issue where hired women had the wrong clothes. This also applies to women after loading from a save.
[*] Fixed an issue where farm 4x4 had a wrong fertilizer decal.
[*] Improved the NPC navigation on a farm. Now NPCs will try to find the nearest possible node to work on a farm instead of forcing themselves to the center of the farm.
[*] Fixed an issue where unlocking technology by investigating plans was removing technology points.
[*] Fixed an issue where some items (like Momma J's soup) were not restored after saving/loading.
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs planted more than the specified number of seeds in a given season.
[*] Richard and Ed now sell bean seed (on existing saves the players have to wait a season for reset).
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix to 1.0.9069
notes.notes:
Howdy partner!

We're working on balancing heat generation. Thus, we bring you some fixes for the thermic system, and more.
[list]
[*] Drinking water from a canteen will decrease the overheat bar now.
[*] Added a new item - Bottle of water - after drinking it, it will decrease the overheat value (availability will be invreased soon).
[*] Drinking from a river will restore the overheat value to zero (some rivers, more to come).
[*] Fixed a problem with saving the technology progress.
[*] Fixed a problem where placing furniture used a glyph icon instead of key code
[*] Fixed the dialogue in Martha’s quest.
[*] Stone Axe – durability and damage increased.
[*] Iron Axe - durability increased.
[*] Woodman Axe - durability increased.
[*] Fixed the bow and arrows issue after they were purchased from the trader in Taxation.
[*] Fixed the interaction with the 4x4 farm.
[*] Added experience as rewards for several quests.
[*] Overheat and freezing bar value will reset to zero after respawning.
[*] Various fixes on the map.
[*] The overheat bar rises much slower now.
[*] The health bar decreases much slower now.
[*] The freezing bar rises much slower
[*] Hand craft icon replaced.
[*] The maximum temperature is reversed back to 41 degrees Celsius.
[/list]
We hear you! Your concerns and observations have not eluded us. We follow everything closely on the forums and are working hard to resolve any problems that arise. That's why we continue to ask you to share your experiences or bug reports with us. All feedback is invaluable to us as it helps us to improve Wild West Dynasty.

We would also like to sincerely thank you for your continued support and patience. We appreciate it all the more at a time when this is not a given. It is very important to us!

We are still working on additional bug fixes in the upcoming days.

notes.title: Version 1.0 is here
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/627f62f29c38593bd2725d7917e0c188bc3766a9.jpg[/img]

Hello Cowgirls and Cowboys,

the time has come.

Wild West Dynasty is shedding its Early Access skin.
We are very excited to share with all of you what we have been working on over the last weeks and months.

And this not only includes loads of major as well as some minor changes to visuals, game mechanics and content based on your feedback that we collected.

We left no stone unturned, starting with a new story over completely fresh gameplay elements and radical changes to almost everything that you know from various Early Access updates.

In short: We believe this is basically a new game, deserving of the label ‚1.0‘. True to the Dynasty DNA, but still trying to walk its own path.

We'd like to thank all of you for your invaluable support, the constructive criticism and the ideas that helped us tremendously to make Wild West Dynasty what it is today!

But we are not done yet.
Because no matter how hard you try, no matter how meticulously you plan: There is never enough time. 

You can rest assured: We are not stopping. And we hope that you come on this exciting journey together with us.
While we tried to make sure to eradicate all bugs, as you know, there is no 100% guarantee that we smashed them all to smithereens.

Depending on different playstyles and some improbabilities we are not able to foresee, within the sandbox play there might be a hiccup – or two. And sometimes it still feels a little rough around the edges. Most of the times that is intentional. 
Occasionally it is not. We will adress that and take care of it.
Because over the next few days and weeks we are not only working on further content and enhancements for Wild West Dynasty.

We will keep an especially keen eye on your feedback.
Because just like in the last few weeks leading up to the playtest and beyond, this game is not ours alone anymore. It is a co-operative effort between you and us.

So just like we did before, we are eager to listen to your feedback.  
If you encounter bugs: Talk to us and we will do everything in our power to fix it. 
Some of them might even be known already and adressed with the updates or hotfixes that will be coming tomorrow and the following days. 
If you are stuck somewhere: Talk to us and/or the community on Discord and we might be able to point you in the right direction.

Tell us what you like. 
And of course, tell us, what you don’t like. We cannot promise that we can change that immediately. But we will listen and evaluate, if we can accomodate your wishes.

We can't wait to hear your feedback and your stories from the all-new Wild West.

Moon Punch Studio and Toplitz Productions

Furthermore we have a new roadmap for you to give an outlook on coming content updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/7040983ff1e4b54029a8ae43b8635d6f5cdcc7c8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Added[/h3]

[*] Hoof sounds

notes.title: Wild West Dynasty - Welcome to Release Town, partner!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/9557cfd70d81f6725e9544f31045c7ce54e67293.png[/img]

Hello cowboys and cowgirls!

The grand day has come, the conductor threw you off the train and your belongings are finally stowed in the carriage. "Dee" and "Lorean", the horses, are harnessed, as the journey continues a little further until you arrive at your destination. Grab the reins and off you go!

What awaits you out there in the prairie of the Wild West?

Hopefully an exciting Wild West story with remarkable characters that should provide plenty of amusement across generations along with the opportunity to build iconic Western towns.

Over the course of the first few months of Early Access, we will not only work optimization and fixes, but on the content of our extensive roadmap that will add more features, the continuation of the main quest, more side quests and a female protagonist!

[previewyoutube=fj8wIYywxig;full][/previewyoutube]

The roadmap until June (subject to adjustments)

[list]
[*] The main story will continue. You won't be left with a cliff-hanger!
[*] More side missions will be added, in which you will get to know even more denizens of Redrock and the prairie.
[*] However, not all the inhabitants are peaceful or well-disposed towards you, you will be faced with bandits and/or go collecting bounties.
[*] We have been very attentive to the feedback we have received and have realised that our protagonist could just as well be a woman. Ergo, you can also play a female character.
[*] To avoid being chronically underchallenged with only solving the worries and needs of the small village, you can enlarge it. There are new foundations and buildings for this purpose.
[*] With new crafting recipes you can increase your arsenal of skills and items.
[*] To ensure that the West remains comprehensible and that there is no rural exodus among the inhabitants, more languages will be added to the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/43cfebf05f2997b9a4cbc092ebfacc56313f9600.png[/img]

With that, we release you into the prairie, partner. Have a wonderful stay in the Wild West! As always, we welcome questions, suggestions, and criticism here in the comments or on our social media channels.

The teams of Moon Punch Studio and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Tuesday. 9:35 a.m. The Release City Express 15 miles outside Release City.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/47558043b6146b7cd3a5c1991e94b771b5d85c3b.png[/img]

[i]"Murph, look up ahead. There's a cow on the tracks!"
"Not again!”
"They're pushing another cow on the tracks!"
"BRAAAAKE!"[/i]

Hello cowboys and cowgirls!

The train to Release City has made its penultimate stop on its route. It's carrying some very important cargo in the mail wagon. So important, in fact, that we'd better tell you about it now before it falls into the hands of bandits. 

Before we hand over the package to you, we wanted to take this opportunity to thank you all for your patience so far, and we hope that you will remain loyal to us until the journey begins. We would like to use the remaining time until the start of Early Access to add a few things to the game and that brings us to the topic at hand. The start of Early Access will be delayed by a few weeks, but we already have a [b]date for the launch: February 16, 2023[/b].
Please excuse the inconvenience in this regard. 

We hope that we can share some gameplay news with you soon, because we have a few things to tell you about it!

In the meantime, we can give you a short glimpse into the revamped world of Wild West Dynasty with our new In-Game-Teaser. As you can see: A lot has happened with the visuals - and there is plenty more, where that came from.

[previewyoutube=zx0R0XkSDjI;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you again for your patience and interest! As always, drop us a line in the comments or on our social media channels! We'll be reading you again soon!

Moon Punch Studio and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Wild West Dynasty - Production Update No. 3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/7ccc76847f317c163a2656a8d4c4ae3fa4d6cb15.jpg[/img]

Howdy partners,

We know that you can't wait to pack your bags, set out to join us in the Wild West and explore this vast new world. The feeling is mutual. However, for a challenging journey like this, goods and luggage need to be transported safely and securely.

For this several types of wagons and carriages were commonly used in the past.

The most popular among them you might have heard about before: the Prairie Schooners, so named after their white canvas tops, gleaming in the distance like the sails of proud ships at sea. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/61441066a8a7be98ae36bfb831bf3e8c0bfd50c2.jpg[/img]

Another vehicle, without which many a daring undertaking would have been doomed to fail, was the Conestoga.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/44ed0f93d3bdd660114a8f7259ef683a568cc926.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/f186cc26571d4ab61238c0a2896cdbab6d781d82.jpg[/img]

As you can see, our goal to make the world that awaits you in Wild West Dynasty as authentic as possible extends to parts like this, too. Among all other things, we want our wagons and carriages to be true to their historical counterparts, in the tiniest graphical detail as well.

Let us know how you like them, and if you have any questions, we will, as always, be happy to answer them in the comment section. 

Stay tuned for more glimpses and updates like this. Talk to you soon Cowboys and Cowgirls!

Yours,
Virtual Magic Games and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Wild West Dynasty - Production Update No. 2
notes.notes:
Howdy partner,

It’s been a while since our last Production Update, so why not break the silence with another one instead! There’s been quite a few things that we worked on since the last time we spoke. One of those things has been the character creation in Wild West Dynasty. So today, we want to talk to you a little bit about it.

One of our goals with Wild West Dynasty is to make its world as authentic as it can be. One way you can introduce authenticity is through variety. Can you imagine living in a village or city and all the people living there looking exactly the same? Neither do we! It would look rather creepy actually, when you think about it. We spent many hours working to make sure that this is not the case. We’ve made a large number of cowboys and cowgirls models and textures so that our people in our game will be unique and special.

First up, we create 3D models of our townsfolk. Believe it or not, some of our models in the game are based on us at the studio. We have scanned a few of our faces and popped it into the Wild West Dynasty’s world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/c967dfad72081183e67debbdaa440105d7f14714.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/8ba7e56e130ca0c8cb611e8c5897afeb3b8afc3e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/bc59d0fd4f18199b0f9fdde6dc7b82f26c3828c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/8e5d3fb0f6d3f56e90170cf200f194104bd4383a.jpg[/img]

[i]And here’s a “bare” 3D model below: [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/b55ec8cc4d93824cc091d82dfdb0d8d5b01b0ddb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/a92d763d55f7af2fd5b793e39dfa6129ac4e8530.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/3d4a13edd7b9eeafacff3a734db72e063fdb84f0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/6346970d7f269f015280b9b30c6708dcd2e0e141.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/cee648bde5a2c787d4ae11c3611f465262e92e18.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/a91e5ac180ffeed9ca00dfaea9b2a558aaf48ca8.png[/img]
[i]Digital models of characters.[/i]

After we created the model, the next step is creating and putting some clothes on them. Working uniform, everyday outfit, special occasion suit - they’re all there. We do a lot of historical research to make sure that we are as historically accurate with our clothes too. And the designs start with concept art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/aa1e71e2828508ef80a1ac10726873fd66f5db0d.png[/img]
[i]Looks like our Cowboy will not be left without garments - original concept art piece.[/i]

We have to admit that this process is a bit time consuming and requires a lot of work on details. But once we have the designs ready, and they’re implemented into the code, it definitely feels worth it. Here’s an example of one character model wearing a few different outfits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/4a4a23a09d4ab5973fc4ec86488bde5aeb7b693d.jpg[/img]
[i]A few examples of clothing options.[/i]

Here is another example of a concept art turned into a 3D model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/94637adfe34c90870d8de9e14f3236d58364f85f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/ecdaf88e590269ec615b8cb655bf6969c4281b0d.png[/img]

And of course, the most important detail, the different styles of long johns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/fe210f7973041ed90cebc7f5c74ca6abbbe88818.jpg[/img]
[i]Comfortable AND stylish. It’s only a matter of time before the long johns make a comeback.[/i]

Apart from clothes, we are also working on our environment - buildings, furniture, saddles, animals, etc etc. There’s a lot of objects and “things” that we are creating to make the world as rich as possible. If you like, we can show you some in our next update. Just let us know below. And as always, let us know what you think of the update, and if you have any questions, just ask us in the comments section.

Stay tuned and speak to you soon Cowboys and Cowgirls!


Yours,

Virtual Magic Games and Toplitz Productions teams

notes.title: Wild West Dynasty - Monthly Update No. 1
notes.notes:
Howdy partner,

Hope you’re doing well and looking forward to settling the frontier! To ease the waiting, we thought that it would be nice to show you what we are working on in the meantime. Wild West Dynasty is still in their early stages of production, but it doesn’t mean that the work is not progressing. With this update we are starting our new Monthly Update series in which we will be showing you our progress. We hope that with these updates, we can bring you into our studio and our workflow. So, without further ado, let’s get straight into this month's progress update! 

One of the things that our concept artists worked on lately are Wild West Dynasty concept art. These drawings are the starting blocks for our game’s visual design and identity. Our artists made, and will still make more of them as our production continues. Below are a few concept art pieces of clothing. Since Wild West Dynasty is based on a specific period of time and history, we’ve collected quite a lot of historical materials as references. We’ve also dug through a lot of historical documents to see how people would wear these clothes, who would wear these clothes, what they were made off, etc etc. These drawings below are the results of this work. We hope you'll like them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/011cc1ac2649cb765d3f690bb2374c34173ce9c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/8694cbacf20d1ae0ce25cc9b70851a188baa96ef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/cc0a935c111d1d64f4ab88c12034394a658287ab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/ba582a50175c6c9aa87000fa1d47676ebe88b6c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/48927070038d6ba0b5149f29582d0ec39222f288.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/1f3ea10f4c306107c0e52d60eefc820f2673c592.png[/img]

[i]Some of our Concept Art Pieces: Costumes.[/i]

Outfits based on original clothing from wild west times is not the only tasks that we’ve been working on. One of the most important things in our game will be the world itself, aka, the map. Deserts, challenging spaces, canyons, rivers, mountains and cliffs, they all have a place somewhere in our world. We started the process of environment creation with a bit of dexterity and spatial imagination. We took all those lessons that we’ve learned as kids, and we let our imagination go free. We bought a whole stack of LEGO bricks and we built the map mock-up using our favourite plastic bricks! It took a good amount of hours of building, but it was worth it. Not only do we have a visual guide, but it also allowed us to talk through the process as well - why are the mountains here, why is the river there, etc etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/20f2b5c6e79ff55392755807031a91dd252dd15e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/fe20dda29205dc88dbe52c826c91704aa4f12fd0.jpg[/img]

[i]LEGO mock-up of the Wild West Dynasty world.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/408b906ea39f651d28a9148bdb1aa8c11c3cd58a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758697/2c7123fc0ad6d3b8008f1a3cc476084d8b486381.jpg[/img]

[i]And here is our LEGO map, inside the engine! And who says that playing with LEGO is a waste of time...[/i]

Ok, it seems that this is a good place to wrap the update up! We worked on other things too but we don’t want to show you too much. There’s nothing worse than an unwanted spoiler ;). We know that there are still a lot of hours of hard work ahead of us, but we’re full of enthusiasm and drive. We are adding something new to the game every day, and that feels nice, for the lack of a better word. It’s nice seeing progress in front of us. 

Let us know if you would like to see more of these types of updates. And do let us know what you think of our concept pieces and our LEGO map too! That free space for your comment below is waiting, so let us know your thoughts. Stay in touch and add us to your Wishlist. We have a lot more upcoming goodies that we want to share with you. 

Until next time cowboys and cowgirls!


Yours,

Virtual Magic Games and Toplitz Productions Teams
